description: Read MapleStory Universe, Nexon's blockchain MapleStory ecosystem, through its Open API: a wallet's NESO, currencies, NFT collections, items and characters; a character's stats, inventory, skills, V-Matrix, quests and history; an NFT item's details and history; the game's item, quest, skill and V-Matrix metadata and the going price of Star Force and Potential enhancement; the marketplace's items, characters and nicknames for sale, with keyword suggestions and valuations; and MapleStory N's reward and raffle data. Read-only, with a builder's API key.
